newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Leumi sets 650 mln shekel 1996 dividend. [CORRECTED 12:29 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Leumi sets 650 mln shekel 1996 dividend. [CORRECTED 12:29 GMT]

text.p: Israel's Bank Leumi said on Monday it would pay an aggregate dividend of 650 million shekels to shareholders, most of it coming from 450 million shekels in gains from the forced sale of non-bank holdings last year.
The remainder of the dividend represents 35 percent of Leumi's 1996 net profit from regular operations.
The bank said its board had agreed after discussions with the Finance Ministry also to fix payouts at 35 percent of net earnings in 1997 and 1998.
Of the 1996 dividend, 530 million shekels will be paid to the government, which holds 72 percent of the bank, and 120 (corrects from 140) million shekels to remaining shareholders.
